subject: [AMBER] frcmod.urea Parameters for urea (or urea-water mixtures).

messages.author: Fabian Glaser
messages.body:
Dear all,
I would like to perform a partial unfolding experiment, for that I would like to use either urea or Guanidinium Chloride equilibrated box at different molars. I would be grateful if somebody could direct me to a good protocol, I have seen several partial protocols on the list, but not a full description of how to do it, or where to obtain an equilibrated box.
Thanks!
Best,
Fabian
